Now I know:
1. Clicking buttons toggles them between white and black
2. Clicking the yellow pieces only advances the HUD

So the only meaningful actions are clicking the buttons. The goal must be to set the buttons to a specific pattern.
Let me think about what pattern the buttons should be in. The yellow pieces might encode the target pattern. Let me reconsider:
- Upper piece: 4x4 block with bottom center gap
- Lower piece: U shape
The buttons are arranged in 3 columns × 2 rows. Maybe the yellow pieces encode which buttons should be ON (black) and which should be OFF (white).
Let me think about the upper piece as a 3×2 pattern:
- The upper piece is 4 columns wide and 4 rows tall
- If I divide it into 3 columns and 2 rows, I get:
  - Top-left: Y, Top-middle: Y, Top-right: Y
  - Bottom-left: Y, Bottom-middle: .., Bottom-right: Y
So the pattern would be: all top buttons ON, left and right bottom buttons ON, middle bottom button OFF.
Mapping to our buttons:
- Horizontal buttons (top row): all ON (black)
- Vertical buttons (bottom row): left ON, middle OFF, right ON
So the target pattern would be:
- Left horizontal: black
- Middle horizontal: black
- Right horizontal: black
- Left vertical: black
- Middle vertical: white
- Right vertical: black
Currently the buttons are:
- Left horizontal: white (www)
- Middle horizontal: black (BBB)
- Right horizontal: black (BBB)
- Left vertical: black (B)
- Middle vertical: black (B)
- Right vertical: black (B)
So I need to:
1. Toggle left horizontal to black (ON)
2. Toggle middle vertical to white (OFF)
Let me try this!
